scenes.anchor_text:
“Above silence, the illuminating storms—dying storms— illuminate the silence above.”
The above sample is noteworthy as it is a ketek, a complex form of holy Vorin poem. The ketek not only reads the same forward and backward  but is also divisible into five distinct smaller sections, each of which makes a complete thought.
scenes.scene_description: A vast, storm-wracked landscape under an alien sky is visualized in response to the ketek. The storm rages, but above and below, an unnerving, almost tangible silence pervades.
